facts.text: I asked whether I should know what Dungeons and Dragons is or the general concept of a tabletop RPG.
I asked for help creating a character for D&D.
I am playing a Warforged artificer.
My ability scores are 15 intelligence, 14 constitution, 13 strength, 12 dexterity, 10 wisdom, and 8 charisma.
My artisan's tools are smith's tools and tinker's tools.
I have a sword that is part of my right arm in addition to the other starting equipment.
I will choose smith's tools for the additional artisan's tools it gives me.
I asked to add thief's tools to my equipment.
I asked to add mending and mage hand to my list of known cantrips.
I asked to add cure wounds, faerie fire, detect magic, and expeditious retreat to my prepared level 1 spells.
I told the assistant to be my DM and that I am playing the character at level 1.
The game begins with my Warforged in a smithy deep under a mountain where creatures of unknown origin begin attacking the miners and smiths.
I stepped away from the project I was working on and investigated where the sounds were coming from.
